text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: anomalous auth flood detected from external IPs (3rd-party indexer). 1.7k auth attempts in 10m. Logs contain `presigned` URLs and S3 object paths. Auto-created incident INC-2026-178. https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-178

sara: oncall sara here, looking now. @oncall-infra can you confirm scope?

oncall-infra: pulling the stream now. initial filter shows entries from `log-forwarder-prod-7` and `staging-forwarder-2` forwarding debug lines with presigned urls. isolating forwarder pool `ffw-7` from egress to external indexer.

vinod: is this affecting prod customer keys or only staging/dev?

julia: grep quick output: `grep -i "presigned" /var/log/forwarder/forwarder.log | head -n 5` shows a handful of staging session urls and one entry with `svc-acct:log-forwarder-prod` metadata. patch incoming to redact debug before forwarder restart.

mike: starting rotation for service account `svc/log-forwarder` now. calling KMS rotate and issuing new AWS keys. will attach rotation job id: rot-2026-02-42. ETA ~8m.

security: tagging @legal-elena and @trust-ops. please prepare timeline and scope. blocklist known indexer IP ranges at edge and CloudWAF. also ensure S3 bucket policy prevents public presigned list indexing.

legal-elena: on it. need list of potentially impacted customers and whether any PHI/PII present. if only staging tokens, likely internal only, but we need confirmation before external notification.

trust-ops: quick check of payloads so far — all sample URLs point to `staging-logs` prefix except one `prod/logs/2026/02/15/debug-xxxxx` reference. pulling object metadata now to see if object contains customer identifiers.

sara: summary of live actions: 1) blocklisted indexer IPs (edge) — DONE. 2) rotated `svc/log-forwarder` keys — IN PROGRESS (mike). 3) killed forwarder pods with old env (julia) and deployed redaction+restart — IN PROGRESS. 4) run full grep across last 48h for `presigned` tokens — julia/mike. 5) revoke sessions for tokens created in last 48h if tied to prod svcacct — vinod. 6) legal to assemble timeline and customer impact statement — legal-elena.

julia: pushing hotfix now: added middleware to redact `?X-Amz-Signature` and `X-Amz-Credential` in logs and to drop presigned URL query params before forwarding. deploy log: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/forwarder -n infra-logs`.

mike: rotation job completed: new keys issued rot-2026-02-42, old keys rotated out and disabled. created emergency IAM credential history entry: https://console.iam/rot-2026-02-42

vinod: I triggered invalidation of sessions tied to `svc/log-forwarder-prod` tokens. curl snippet for reference: ```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://auth.internal/v1/sessions/invalidate -d '{"principal":"svc/log-forwarder-prod","older_than_minutes":1}'
```

security: confirming we also pushed a CloudWAF rule to block the indexer user-agent and IP CIDRs. telemetry shows hit rate for those IPs dropping to near zero.

trust-ops: inspected the single prod object — metadata indicates no customer identifiers; contents appear to be debug traces with rotated IDs. marking as low exposure for now but continuing deeper scan.

legal-elena: drafting TOC for external-facing message in case we need it. please hold notification until we confirm no prod key exposure. if we confirm prod exposure, we will follow the regulatory notification playbook.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-178 severity set to S2. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/log-forwarder-presigned-leak, slack channel: #inc-INC-2026-178.

sara: good progress. plan: small team (sara, mike, julia, vinod, security, legal-elena, trust-ops) will continue live mitigation for 60m. I'll update every 15m or earlier if scope changes. handoff to next oncall @ 1711119488 if needed. ping me for transfer. :thumbsup:

mike: confirmed edge blocks + rotation completed + forwarder redaction deployed. monitoring 5m.

julia: grep across last 48h finished, found 27 presigned references; 26 staging, 1 prod (already inspected). upload of artifacts to incident folder: s3://incidents/INC-2026-178/artifacts/list-1711118888.txt

vinod: marking customer-impact: none at this time. will update if trust-ops finds anything.

security: next steps: full log retention freeze for impacted buckets, preserve evidence, disable old creds in IAM, and schedule follow-up forensic window with infra.

legal-elena: will coordinate customer comms template and copy to #security-notify.

sara: locking thread. if nothing new in next 30m we'll move to monitoring state and create follow-up postmortem. thanks team.
